differences.what: Overall color temperature is wrong: the capture is cold navy/blue-gray throughout, while the reference is dominated by warm amber/orange lantern and bulb light, with pink, cyan and purple neon only as accents.
differences.where: Whole frame, worst on the left stairs, the bridge underside and the sidewalk
differences.fix: Drop the blue ambient/fill to near-black. Make warm point lights (2700K amber) from lanterns, string bulbs and step lights the main light sources, so the surfaces facing them glow orange. Keep the cool tones only in the sky and the distant towers.

differences.what: The footbridge is a bare gray box with flat white-gray panel railings. The reference's bridge is dark wood and metal with a dense garden of hanging vines and purple wisteria, a sagging string of warm and colored bulbs along its whole length, and paper lanterns hung on posts.
differences.where: Center-left to center, the elevated walkway spanning the frame
differences.fix: Replace the white panels with a dark metal or wood railing. Hang trailing ivy and purple wisteria clusters along the whole outer face. Add a catenary string of about 40 emissive bulbs (mostly warm, some red, green and cyan) above the deck, plus 4–5 glowing white paper lanterns with a water-drop logo on posts.

differences.what: The bridge underside has no cyan neon strip and no neon coffee-cup sign. Instead it shows a few cold white fluorescent bars.
differences.where: Underside and outer edge of the bridge, center
differences.fix: Run a thin emissive cyan/blue LED strip along the bridge's lower outer edge. Mount a pink neon coffee-cup sign on the bridge fascia just left of the cafe. Swap the white fluorescent bars for warm round downlights spaced along the soffit.

differences.what: The left staircase is flat, untextured dark gray with no lighting. The reference stairs are warm wood with a glowing amber LED strip under every tread nose, and plants and lanterns line both sides.
differences.fix: Give the stairs a wet dark-wood material and an emissive warm strip under each step nose. Add potted ferns and ivy along the stringers, a large white paper lantern with a water-drop logo at the bottom left, and a chalkboard A-frame sign reading 'テラス席 ↑' at the base.

differences.what: The left building is blank: dark walls with a stray red/green/blue blob. The reference has a tall glass storefront with warm-lit interior windows, wooden mullions, hanging plants and lanterns.
differences.where: Far left edge, top to middle
differences.fix: Model a multi-story glazed facade with wooden frames and warm emissive interiors behind the glass, plus trailing plants and 2–3 lanterns. Remove the RGB blob.

differences.what: A huge overexposed cyan bloom blob sits where the reference has a vertical pink-magenta neon sign reading 茶房雫. The cafe has no readable signage.
differences.where: Top center-right, above the cafe building
differences.fix: Delete the cyan blob. Mount a vertical pink neon sign with the characters 茶房雫, with moderate bloom so the glyphs stay legible. Add a tall cyan neon sign on the tower behind it, top center-right.

differences.what: The crosswalk is a grid of floating, disconnected white rectangular slabs that read like stepping stones in water. The reference has long continuous white zebra bars painted flat on the asphalt, running diagonally toward the right.
differences.fix: Replace the slabs with flat painted decals: 6–8 long parallel white stripes about 0.5 m wide, fused to the road plane with no thickness, oriented like the reference. Make them slightly glossy and wet so the reflections continue across them.

differences.what: The wet street reads as a flooded canal: large wavy, rippling water with smeared, choppy reflections. The reference is a wet asphalt mirror with crisp vertical light streaks in warm orange, pink and cyan under each light source.
differences.where: Center street from the midground to the foreground
differences.fix: Remove the water plane and ripple distortion. Use dark asphalt with low roughness (0.05–0.15) and screen-space or planar reflections, plus a slight vertical stretch so each lantern and neon throws a long colored streak. Add only small puddle normals.

differences.what: The ほしマート convenience store in the background is a blank white box with no signage. The reference shows a bright storefront with an orange/blue striped band, a 'ほしマート' sign with a star, and a lit glass front. The background also lacks the second steel stair.
differences.fix: Add a white sign band with orange and blue stripes and '★ほしマート' text. Light the shelves behind full-height glass. Keep the dark metal stair rising to the bridge to its right, and add pedestrians-free umbrella-height warm spill light on the pavement in front.

differences.what: The rain is far too heavy and too bright. Thick white streaks cover the whole frame and flatten the depth, while the reference rain is subtle, thin and visible mainly against the lights. The props are also sparse: no koi streamer lit up, no potted plants along the street, no second vending machine, no lanterns on the right-hand stall, and the skyscrapers are flat slabs with sparse random dots instead of regular lit window grids.
differences.where: Whole frame (rain); right side and background (props, towers)
differences.fix: Cut rain particle count and opacity by about 70%, and make the streaks thin and short so they catch light only near emissives. Add an orange koi streamer on the cafe, potted shrubs along the curb, a white drink vending machine at the far right, and warm lanterns on the red-awning stall. Rebuild the towers with structured grids of warm and cool lit windows, plus purple and cyan neon accents on the skyline.
